text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the adoption of a by-law to prohibit trucks and other heavy vehicles along Bluebird Place in order to prevent the use and parking of such vehicles along this new local road.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited heavy vehicles at all times on Bluebird Place, between Kirkdene Drive and the south end of Bluebird Place. 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for northbound traffic on Bluebird Place at Kirkdene Drive.
